name: tps25940l
watch_out_for: Pinout and RVC0020A lands reviewed against TI SLVSCF3A. Pin 4 is the ERC output driver; internally common OUT pins 5-8 are passive and must all be connected. Ground exposed pad 21 has six 0.30 mm thermal drills with rear mask tenting; two paste windows follow TI's 81% coverage example. Wider imported perimeter lands retain lead coverage. Verify assembly stencil and thermal copper for the complete circuit; not assembled-hardware validation.
